name: hop_route
purpose: Mid-walk: which hop should the walker visit next? Choice over the planes; the LLM takes over when unsure.
state_template: TRAJECTORY: <case, work id, symptom, hops visited so far and what each showed, remaining hypotheses>.

next_hop.instructions: Given the trajectory so far, which hop should the walker visit next?

criteria.user_plane: Ask the user-plane hop — what the person or client did
criteria.edge_plane: Walk the edge hop — gateway, proxy, entry service
criteria.service_plane: Walk the service hop — the application logic
criteria.data_plane: Walk the data hop — database, cache, storage
criteria.queue_plane: Walk the queue hop — broker, async work
criteria.platform_plane: Walk the platform hop — runtime, host, scheduler
criteria.network_plane: Walk the network hop — link, DNS, routing
criteria.business_plane: Check the business plane — money moved, state changed
criteria.close_walk: Enough evidence — synthesize the root cause
criteria.escalate_to_llm: The trajectory is ambiguous — let the LLM reason
